Chapter Three: Adjustments

Article 49: Adjustment of Output Tax

1. A taxable person may adjust output tax where a tax invoice is wholly or partly cancelled or
   the consideration for a supply is altered.
   (a) The adjustment must be evidenced by a credit or debit note.
   (b) The note must reference the original tax invoice number.

2. No adjustment under paragraph 1 shall be made after the end of the calendar year following
   the year in which the original supply was made, as provided in Article 51.

Article 50: Adjustment of Input Tax

1. A taxable person who has deducted input tax on a supply must adjust that deduction where
   the supply is subsequently cancelled or its consideration is reduced, in accordance with
   Article 49.

Article 51: Time Limits for Adjustments

1. The time limit referred to in Article 49 does not apply where the adjustment arises from a
   court judgment.
   (a) The taxable person must retain the judgment as supporting evidence.
